The Tecur approach

ABOUT TECUR
AUTOMOTIVE.

We are an independent Toyota workshop in Lekki, Lagos. We help drivers with repairs, servicing and spare parts.

Independent Toyota expertise

OUR WORKSHOP
IN LEKKI.

Tecur Automotive focuses on Toyota service, repair and parts enquiries in Lekki, Lagos. From diagnostics and electrical work to cooling systems and planned maintenance, our approach starts with listening and inspection.

We offer workshop visits and mobile service for suitable jobs. Before work begins, we discuss the findings and the proposed next steps so you can make an informed decision.

Our workshop is at 2 Lawal St, Lekki Peninsula II. We serve owners around Jakande, Agungi, Osapa, Chevron and VGC.
